hospital.name: Lotus Crest Institute of Medical Sciences

bio: Haematologist leading the bone marrow transplant unit, including haplo-identical transplants for children with thalassaemia.

inclusions: Surgeon, anaesthetist and procedure fees
Operation theatre charges and standard consumables
30-night stay in a private room
Nursing care and routine medicines during the stay
Recipient and living-donor surgery and ICU stay as per protocol
Initial immunosuppression during the stay
Help with authorisation-committee documentation
Pre-procedure tests listed in the treatment plan
Review consultation before you fly home
exclusions: Treatment of unrelated or pre-existing conditions
Extended ICU stay or care for complications beyond the plan
Accommodation outside the hospital (see the Medical + Stay package)
Donor work-up done outside the hospital

packages.name: Medical Only
packages.description: Treatment as per the hospital plan: 30-night hospital stay, procedure and doctor fees and standard medicines. Travel and accommodation arranged separately.

packages.name: Medical + Stay
packages.description: Everything in Medical Only, plus 60 nights at a partner hotel near the hospital and airport pickup and drop.

packages.name: All-Inclusive
packages.description: Everything in Medical + Stay, plus a medical interpreter, daily meals, local transport for appointments and 3 follow-up video consultations after you return home.
